title: Propagated beyond-VRAM case: a silicon-nitride pillar-array lens lit by a plane-wave pulse, a downsampled six-component output plane at three wavelengths, an angular-spectrum focal objective and the dense epsilon VJP through the streamed plane adjoint; judged at 64 um on the local RTX 3060 (rtx3060-win11-lab), with the 120 um RTX 5880 run kept as an optional larger instance

fixture.device: Square array of cylindrical pillars (epsilon 4.0, silicon nitride at 1.55 um) on a 1.0 um period, 0.6 um tall, in air with no substrate. The radius of each pillar is the hyperbolic lens phase of a 150 um focal length at 1.55 um wrapped onto 0.15 to 0.42 um; the array is lens-like and its focusing efficiency is not claimed. The geometry is rasterized on cell centres into the epsilon tensor (no project structures).
fixture.source: soft Ex plane sheet at z = -0.8 um spanning the lateral CPML (extend_through_pml), Gaussian pulse of 15 fs power FWHM centred at 30 fs, carrier 1.55 um; the source envelope ends at 84.7 fs
fixture.monitor: z-normal FieldMonitor at z = +0.6 um (0.4 um above the pillar tops) spanning the footprint, downsample 8 (0.4 um samples, sin(theta_max) = 1.55/0.8 covers every propagating angle), six components, DFT at 1.65, 1.55 and 1.45 um
fixture.objective: sum over the three wavelengths of |E|^2 on the axis 150 um beyond the monitor plane, evaluated by torchfdtd.angular_spectrum.propagate_points (pad 3) on the plane spectrum divided by dt x steps so that FP32 seeds stay of order one
fixture.design_variable: dense cell-centred epsilon (float32, one value per cell); the design slab is the pillar layers 24 to 35

rehearsal.modes: resident (AdjointOptions checkpoints 8 on host) and streamed (slab width 32, temporal depth 16, checkpoints 2, local checkpoints 1, host banks, 6 GiB host and 1.5 GiB GPU budgets) on the local RTX 3060
rehearsal.supplementary: a 24 um streamed-only member (520 x 520 x 64, 17.3 million cells, 172,800 observers, W=32, K=16, C=4, L=1) with the one-sided difference, docs/validation/g5/G5-05_rehearsal_3060_streamed_24um.json; not judged by this case

reference_method: Directional central finite difference of the same objective along the pillar direction delta (indicator of the pillar cells whose centres lie within 10 um of the axis, over the design slab), two extra streamed forwards in the judged, the optional and the rehearsal runs; in the rehearsal the resident DifferentiablePlaneSimulation on the same grid, sources, monitor and objective is the second reference for the objective and the design-slab gradient.

observables.name: objective
observables.definition: sum over the wavelengths of the on-axis focal intensity

observables.name: focal_intensity_per_frequency
observables.definition: the three terms of the objective

observables.name: plane_electric_energy_per_frequency
observables.definition: |E|^2 integrated over the plane quadrature at each wavelength

observables.name: energy_history
observables.definition: per time step, the sum of squares of the electric Yee samples feeding the plane interpolation (artifact streamed_energy_history.npy)

observables.name: energy_peak_step, energy_rise_step, energy_decayed_fraction
observables.definition: argmax of the history, first step above 1e-3 of the peak, final value over the peak

observables.name: gradient_norm, design_slab_gradient_norm, gradient_nonzero
observables.definition: L2 norms of the dense VJP and of its pillar-layer slab (artifact streamed_design_slab_gradient.npy), count of nonzero entries

observables.name: directional_derivative, finite_difference, relative_error, relative_response
observables.definition: sum of the gradient over the direction cells, (J(eps + h delta) - J(eps)) / h or the central form, |fd - d| / |d|, |delta J| / J

observables.name: frequency_resolution_hz, source_amplitude_ratio
observables.definition: 1 / duration; amplitude spectrum of the sampled source waveform at each wavelength over its peak

propagation.justification: Exploratory streamed forwards of 12 um and 20 um members of the same family reached 1.7e-4 and 2.1e-4 at 160 fs and about 1.5e-4 at 175 fs; the limit leaves a factor of about six for slower lateral leakage of the larger array. A tail of 1e-3 in energy is 3 percent in field amplitude, the truncation error accepted for the spectrum.

spectrum.justification: 1 / 175 fs = 5.71 THz against the 11.72 THz between 1.65 and 1.55 um (0.487); the source amplitude at the three wavelengths is 0.80, 0.99 and 0.75 of its peak.

gradient.justification: The step changes the pillar index by 0.6 percent over 316 pillars (7.7 percent of the 64 um array judged on the RTX 3060, 2.2 percent of the optional 120 um array) and over all 196 pillars in the rehearsal. Both contexts use the central difference: the 14 um rehearsal gave a central relative error of 9.1e-3 at a 26 percent response, while the supplementary 24 um streamed run showed that the one-sided difference at this step carries a 14.7 percent truncation error at a 1.9 percent response (the pillar transmission is strongly nonlinear in epsilon near its resonances), so the one-sided form first declared for the workstation was replaced by the central form before the judged run at the cost of one more forward. The judged and the optional runs keep the 5 percent originally declared for the workstation run and the rehearsal the program's 3 percent physical-parameter threshold. A response below 2e-4 of the objective would sit near the FP32 floor of a 1836-step spectrum and is declared inconclusive (FAIL).

resident_agreement.applies_to: rehearsal only; the judged and optional runs have no resident reference

acceptance.source_of_limits: fixture-specific budgets declared here; resident agreement from proposed_thresholds.discrete_dimensionless_fp32

not_yet_covered: the judged run itself: tests/test_beyond_vram_propagated.py judges the rehearsal record and the report rendering; the RTX 3060 record must be rendered with benchmarks/report_beyond_vram_propagated.py --context rtx3060 into docs/validation/beyond_vram_propagated_3060.json, after which test_judged_record_meets_g5_05 judges it
a restart journal on the spectral path

an E/H state that exceeds physical VRAM by itself: on the RTX 3060 that needs at least 0.54 billion cells whose host banks alone exceed the machine, on the RTX 5880 at least 2.1 billion cells at about six times the three-hour budget

notes: Applicability: the judged run is the 64 um instance on rtx3060-win11-lab (context rtx3060); the rehearsal verifies the driver, the criteria machinery, the resident/streamed agreement and the central finite difference at 1/17 of its cells on the same GPU; the 120 um RTX 5880 instance (context rtx5880) is optional. G5-05 stays NOT_RUN until the RTX 3060 record is judged. History: the case was first declared for the RTX 5880 at 120 um (commit following 73203d2; the 1.2 to 1.6 billion cell target of the brief was reduced to 381 million cells because host banks of five states plus eight dense parameter copies exceed the 103 GB admissible there above about 0.45 billion cells and the fitted wall-time model gave 1.39 h against the 3 h budget); before any judged run the workstation finite difference was changed from one-sided to central (commit after 3b0deb0) on the evidence of the supplementary 24 um streamed rehearsal (one-sided relative error 0.147 at a 0.019 response), and then, on the owner's decision that local verification is sufficient, the judged instance was re-scoped to the RTX 3060 at 64 um with six global checkpoints so that the live adjoint state (32.9 GB) exceeds its 12.9 GB of VRAM by a clear margin while the host reservation (41.1 GB) stays under 60 GB of the 85.6 GB of RAM; physics, criteria and limits are unchanged. Exploratory probes before the first declaration: resident 12 um at 2600 steps and streamed 20 um at 2518 steps for the energy decay, and an 8 um, 300-step run of the driver in both modes (finite-difference relative error 5e-4 at a 2.9 percent response, resident/streamed gradient relative L2 3.9e-7). Re-declared before the judged run on 2026-09-22: the 64 um instance needs a 41.1 GB host reservation but this workstation had only 30.8 GB of available RAM at run time (other users' processes), so the judged RTX 3060 instance is the 44 um member of the same family: grid 920 x 920 x 64 = 54,169,600 cells, E/H 1.30 GB, streamed state 1.59 GB, 9 host banks, dense parameter reservation 1.73 GB, host reservation 21.4 GB, GPU reservation 4.5 GB, fitted estimate 0.72 h. Its live adjoint state (9 x 1.59 GB banks plus 1.73 GB parameters, 16.1 GB) exceeds the 12.88 GB physical VRAM by 1.25 times, against 2.55 times for the 64 um instance, which stays declared as the larger optional run (context rtx3060_64um) for a host with 52 GB available.
